summary: Giulio2002 提交 Scheme-Agile Transactions（EIP-8202），只把 EIP-1559 交易的 v、r、s 换成 scheme_id 与 signature_data，并在 Magicians 发长文论证这比 frame 交易更便宜、更简单的后量子路径，引发 41 帖讨论。ladislaus0x 提醒 ACD 本周四将决定 EIP-8141 是否进入 Hegotá。ACDT #75 讨论 ePBS 的 PTC 缓存窗口。

items.topic: 原生 AA 与后量子交易：路线之争
items.title: 新增 EIP：Scheme-Agile Transactions
items.note: （Giulio2002）提交；Magicians 讨论帖 EIP-8202 05:13：不引入新操作码、账户抽象或执行 frame，只新增一个复用 EIP-1559 字段的交易类型，把 v、r、s 换成 scheme_id 与 signature_data；作者认为 frame 方案在内存池验证上仍有未解问题，frame 可以日后叠加。
items.note_en: (Giulio2002), submitted; Magicians thread EIP-8202, 05:13: no new opcodes, account abstraction or execution frames, just one new transaction type reusing EIP-1559 fields with v, r, s replaced by scheme_id and signature_data; the author argues frame designs still have unresolved mempool validation issues and frames can be layered on later.
items.topic_en: Native AA and PQ transactions: the route debate

summary_en: Giulio2002 submitted Scheme-Agile Transactions (EIP-8202), which only replaces the v, r, s fields of an EIP-1559 transaction with scheme_id and signature_data, and argued in a long Magicians post that this is a cheaper, simpler post-quantum path than frame transactions, drawing 41 posts. ladislaus0x noted ACD will decide on EIP-8141 for Hegotá this Thursday. ACDT #75 discussed the ePBS cached PTC window.
